candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/24 on sw-it-01 allows VLANs {10,30,99}, but the approved set for this trunk is {30,99}, so zone VLAN 10 is carried onto the CORP switch.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 10 from the allowed list of sw-it-01 Gi1/0/24 so that it carries only {30,99}.

candidates.claim: The switchport trunk allowed list on sw-it-01 interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24 changed from the approved baseline [30,99] to [10,30,99] and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Revert the trunk allowed list on sw-it-01 Gi1/0/24 to the approved baseline [30,99], or document and approve the change.
